verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's own materials cover O-1A, O-1B, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, TN, E-3, L-1A and E-2, the last via an eligibility quiz and a treaty-country guide. For choosing among them, it offers a side-by-side pathway comparison, TN advice on pairing pathways, a cost comparison, and criteria self-assessment quizzes. H-1B appears only indirectly, through an H-4 dependent guide, and cap-exempt routes are never mentioned. Missing for 10: a dedicated H-1B page, any cap-exempt H-1B coverage, founder-specific selection guidance across the full menu, and independent corroboration.
